content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 20 was a one-way Customer indemnity ("every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services") with no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement — walk-away territory under INDEMN. I proposed a preferred-level cure: a new § 20.2 Vendor defence/indemnity (Services or Deliverable IP infringement, Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, Vendor's gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, plus a surgical narrowing of § 20.1 to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law. The dangling § 9.3 reference to "Section 20.5" is flagged in the rationale as the point to fill if Vendor moves to the fallback (customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund, 3× annual fee super-cap).
